headline: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Week 47 of 2026: Equity Turnover Drops -26.64% to TZS 26.42 Billion as TTP (+11.48%) Leads as Best Stock Performer
summary: Equity turnover fell 26.64% to TZS 26.42 billion in the week of November 16-20, with TTP up 11.48% as the top performer. Total market capitalisation closed at TZS 38,445.50 billion.
why: The Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange is Tanzania's main securities market, and its trading activity reflects local investor demand for listed equities.
